written.myAnswer: Renewable energy sources are replaced by new ones after use. Non-renewable sources are depleted with continuous use and are not easily replaced once exhausted.
Yes. Timber or wood can be a renewable source of heat energy when trees are replanted and allowed to grow back; it can be depleted if trees are cut faster than they are replaced.

Renewable sources are replaced by new ones after use; examples include hydroelectricity, solar energy and wind energy. Non-renewable sources are depleted with continuous use and are not easily replaced; examples include coal, petroleum and natural gas.
